result.title: Invertible Graph Aggregation Can Increase ReLU Readout Width
result.comment: 12 pages, 4 figures. Code and reproducibility materials: https://github.com/usamihiroyasu/invertible-graph-readout-width
result.summary: An invertible graph aggregation preserves the complete feature table, but can increase the size of a classifier that reads one node at a time. For every even $N\ge4$, we construct a labeled tree with $2N$ vertices and maximum degree three. A shared one-hidden-layer rectified linear unit (ReLU) classifier needs one hidden unit on the raw scalar features and exactly $N$ units after one lazy neighborhood mean. All aggregate values are distinct, and the mixing matrix has condition number at most 8. We determine the complete error curve for heads with a free affine term. The width separation persists under scalar perturbations. Under a specified bounded uniform-noise model with one nuisance coordinate, every one-unit aggregate head has expected error at least $1/12$, while a fixed $N$-unit head has zero error. Controlled fits compare trained heads with these explicit feasible scores. On Roman-empire and Tolokers, aggregation improves fitted prediction, and retaining raw features helps at the largest tested parameter budget. Training-only diagnostics include conditional output-layer optimality bounds for eight fixed runs.

AI.brief_summary: 论文构造带标签树与共享单隐层 ReLU 读出器，证明可逆的邻域均值聚合会把原本 1 个隐单元即可拟合的分类器撑到 N 个单元，并分析误差曲线、噪声模型下的稳健性及两个图基准上的拟合表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于图神经网络聚合与读出表达性的宽度分离理论，材料未涉及视觉或多模态推理的状态表示、证据筛选、latent 生成或停止决策，也无可供迁移的具体方法线索。
